attempts.text:
Car2 cannot move. Its only road out of Dhunche hospital is blocked by the landslide, so the plan uses car1 alone. I treated the Benighat–Gajuri road as impassable because of the fast floodwater, and I did not use Bidur temple because it is not a designated drop-off point. Three adults are deferred because collecting them would cost more driving than their penalty (20 each).
